short_answer.normalization_rule: normalize decimal comma to point for comparison; trim whitespace; do not accept expressions, fractions or units as short answer
short_answer.scoring: exact normalized numeric value per official answer table; 1 point each

extended_answer.scoring: no automatic content score; after completion user self-assesses against official 2025 criteria
extended_answer.separation: self-assessment points are displayed separately from automatic 1–12 points until combined explicitly on result screen
